acceptance_criteria.statement: Runtime and agent-pack schema define one backward-compatible externalRead shape with array domains/methods and empty defaults.
Domains accept explicit ASCII LAN/DNS and raw IPv4/IPv6 values, canonicalize host names, and reject unsafe or malformed entries with controlled PolicyError.
Methods fail closed on malformed types and remain GET-only without unknown exceptions.
Compiled grant arrays are defensive frozen copies and deterministic tests prove behavior without network access or dependencies.
Full Node tests and git whitespace check pass within the allowed paths.
